name: getDefineMasterDateDetails
description: Before executing in this tool, first call the "masterDataTypes" API to retrieve the available data types. Then extract the values for masterDataType, masterDataTypeIndex, and masterDataTypeValue. If the user attempts to update a master data type or any thing, check if any data types are available. If none are found, display a message stating, "No available data types."
